name: shopme
description: SHOPME clothing & fashion store: customer website, admin panel and backend

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,shop,admin -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
